plugins.description: UX/UI design mastery plugin — 30 ordered steps across 7 phases guiding the complete product design lifecycle. GROUND → DISCOVER → SHAPE → AUDIT → BUILD → VALIDATE → LAUNCH. Visual design mastery (36+ designers, 70 rules, Awwwards scoring), platform standards (iOS 26 Liquid Glass, M3 Expressive, CSS 2025-2026, 9 devices), AI generation (Stitch MCP, Fal.ai 600+ models), UI patterns (200+ patterns, 50+ benchmarks, 100+ anti-patterns), user research, wireframing, usability testing, design QA, pre-launch checklist, post-launch iteration.
